announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Shareholding
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates that a director or person discharging managerial responsibilities has dealt in the company's shares, which is a routine disclosure of insider trading activity. It provides limited insight into future performance but confirms compliance with market abuse regulations regarding insider transactions.
